verdict.rationale: AutoGen's official GitHub README shows an assistant agent that uses the Playwright MCP server. Combined with the documented tool-using AssistantAgent, this shows AutoGen can consume an external MCP server's tools. The evidence is a single README example, though, with no dedicated documentation of the MCP integration. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on MCP client setup (transports, configuration, connecting multiple servers), evidence it works with MCP servers beyond Playwright, independent or hands-on corroboration.
